headline: Man City rout Palace; Villa land Jackson, near Mbaye deal
paragraphs: Manchester City beat Crystal Palace 4-1, with Rayan Cherki and Erling Haaland both scoring twice — a result Sky Sports, BBC Sport and the Guardian covered independently, with BBC Sport running three separate pieces including match ratings. Sky Sports said the win kept City perfect in the Premier League so far. Separately, manager Enzo Maresca told Sky that Jack Grealish's future would be decided before the transfer deadline.

Aston Villa confirmed the club-record signing of Chelsea forward Nicolas Jackson, per Sky Sports. Sky Sports, the Guardian and Transfermarkt separately reported Villa had reached only a verbal agreement, not yet an official deal, to sign Paris Saint-Germain winger Ibrahim Mbaye, a player Transfermarkt notes had also drawn earlier interest from Liverpool. Ollie Watkins, the forward Jackson replaces, is reported by Sky Sports to be undergoing a medical ahead of a move to Al-Hilal.

Arsenal's chase of Atletico Madrid's Julian Alvarez remains unresolved: Sky Sports reports Atletico have given the striker until Sunday to decide between staying or joining Arsenal. Sky Sports separately cited newspaper reports of Arsenal in talks with Real Madrid over forward Endrick, flagged only as 'paper talk' and unconfirmed. On Liverpool, outlets disagree on Harvey Elliott's likely suitor: Sky Sports and BBC Gossip name Valencia, while the Guardian lists Napoli or Lazio instead.
